title: ggpaintr
text:
Welcome
This is the work-in-progress book for ggpaintr, an R package that turns ggplot-like formula strings into Shiny apps: placeholder tokens in the formula (var, text, num, expr, upload) become input widgets automatically.
The book teaches how to use ggpaintr and how to extend it. It is purely user-facing; design ideas live in the package repository, not here.

title: ggpaintr
text:
Version this book documents
This book is pinned to ggpaintr @beec4325 (the post-ADR-0006 / post-ADR-0010 development tip — no tagged release covers this API yet). The pin lives in DESCRIPTION Remotes: and is enforced by Rscript dev/book-gate.R. To follow along with the same version:
remotes::install_github("willju-wangqian/ggpaintr@beec43259ef3df7490e08944bb4a79cd8655b0c5")
When the package cuts a tagged release covering the API in this book, the pin will move to that tag in a single PR; the install snippet above will update accordingly.

title: ggpaintr
text:
Who this is for
Readers who know ggplot2 and Shiny basics and want to build, embed, customize, or extend ggpaintr-driven plotting apps.

title: ggpaintr
ggpaintr

This book lives in its own repository, separate from the ggpaintr package (mirroring how the ggplot2 book is separate from ggplot2). See README.md for build/deploy.
